articles.summary: The Customer Identification Program rule requires banks to verify customer identity at account opening. The FinCEN ruling changes what counts as acceptable evidence.
articles.title: What Is a Customer Identification Program (CIP), and How Do Digital Credentials Change It?

articles.summary: When federal banking regulators recognize verifiable digital credentials for customer identification, digital identity stops being a government IT project and becomes financial infrastructure.
articles.title: The FinCEN Ruling Proves Digital Identity Is Financial Infrastructure
